capabilities: track daily net new words per note and folder
send a webhook when the daily word goal is reached
display a heatmap sidebar with streaks and goal shading
open the matching daily note from a heatmap day
import past word counts from daily notes
extras: README warns that file-sync services (iCloud, Dropbox, OneDrive) can make data.json appear missing or stale and overwrite history; the plugin keeps three guarded local backups and mentions Obsidian Sync as an option. Manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's word count measures total file length, so it cannot track how many new words you write each day, streaks, or goal completion.

relations.evidence: The plugin uses your Periodic Notes daily settings first, then Obsidian's core Daily Notes settings

summary: Daily word-goal tracker that counts net new words per day, fires a webhook when the goal is met, and shows a heatmap sidebar with detailed stats.
